description: Local-first note-taking and course material manager with embedded Markdown (.md) and LaTeX (.tex) editors.

tech_stack.database: SQLite (local-first, managed by Rust backend like Linux package managers)
tech_stack.editors: Markdown and LaTeX editors with KaTeX math rendering

files.AGENTS.md: Agent working memory, tech decisions, finished tasks progress, and rules.
files.package.json: Frontend NPM package configuration with @tauri-apps/cli dependency.

./.description: Architecture, database design, and environment specifications (design/)

files.database_design.json: Database tables and relationships schema specification (subjects, threads, files, tasks).
files.dev_env.json: Development directory and component map for rapid agent/developer navigation.
files.production_directory_tree.json: Production app storage and directory tree specification following Linux Package Manager principles.

files.main.js: Client-side script handling UI logic and Tauri backend IPC invokes.
files.assets/: Static frontend images and SVGs (tauri.svg, javascript.svg).

../src-tauri/.description: Tauri v2 Rust backend and application packaging configuration (src-tauri/)

files.Cargo.toml: Rust dependencies (tauri, rusqlite, serde, uuid, chrono, thiserror).
files.tauri.conf.json: Tauri v2 runtime configuration (app identifier, window dimensions, frontendDist).
files.capabilities/default.json: Tauri window security capabilities and permissions.
files.icons/: Application launcher icons for multiple platforms.

files.main.rs: Desktop application executable entry point, calls noteman_lib::run().
files.lib.rs: App library setup, initializes DbManager in Tauri state, registers all IPC commands.

../src-tauri/src/db/.description: SQLite database and package-manager-style file storage backend module (src-tauri/src/db/)

files.mod.rs: Re-exports commands, manager, models, schema, and error types.
files.schema.rs: SQLite DDL schema, tables (subjects, threads, files, tasks), indexes, PRAGMAs (WAL, foreign_keys).
files.models.rs: Rust struct definitions, DTOs (Subject, Thread, FileRecord, Task), and DbStats.
files.error.rs: DbError enum handling rusqlite, IO, validation, and concurrency errors.
files.manager.rs: DbManager core engine handling DB connection, CRUD, file disk storage, cascading deletes, and integrity checks. MUST enforce atomic operations for file/DB sync to prevent orphaned files.
files.commands.rs: Tauri command handlers exposing all DB and file management capabilities to frontend.
